_about: Public-domain John Kitto (1804-1854, deaf biblical scholar) for the Word Hoard: the eight-volume Daily Bible Illustrations (New York: Carter printings, 1851-1860) and 10 more books from Internet Archive scans, 1841-1851: Palestine (two volumes, 1841), The Pictorial History of Palestine (two volumes, 1844), A Pictorial Life of Our Saviour (1847), Scripture Lands (1850), The History of Palestine (1851), The Land of Promise, The Court of Persia and The People of Persia. Raw OCR. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 20 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
